snippets.text: The checkout completion rate fell 14.0 percentage points [ref-funnel]. Mobile card timeouts rose from 0 to 180 [ref-payment]. The October 21 rollout aligns with the change, so compare exposure cohorts before attributing cause [ref-release].
Something broke. Bad deployment.
The checked funnel dropped from 870 to 723 purchases [ref-funnel]. Compare the checkout population with the previous window.
The rollout caused an 80 percentage-point loss in conversions [ref-release].
Payments showed 180 current mobile card timeouts [ref-payment]. The observed increase may contribute to missed orders, but cohort exposure remains unknown [ref-release].

Current traffic has zero recorded days versus three baseline days [ref-coverage], so a comparable conversion estimate is unavailable. The collector change is a candidate to inspect [ref-collector]. Recover telemetry before estimating impact.
Conversions went to zero. Roll the collector back.
